about.headline: Engineering panels in Bengaluru since 2008.
story: We started building electrical panels in Bengaluru in 2008 as Venus Enterprises, and incorporated as Poweramps Technology Pvt. Ltd. in 2013. Since then we have manufactured, supplied and serviced electrical panels and control equipment. Our range covers motor control centres, PLC and VFD automation panels, AMF and DG synchronization panels, fire-fighting controls, UPS distribution, remote power panels and bus duct tap-off boxes.

Led by directors K. V. V. Chalapathi and Rajshekar, our team combines in-house design, fabrication and testing with installation and maintenance services. Every panel is built from quality components sourced from trusted vendors, and we deal transparently and deliver on time.
